name: eglo-bridge-mcp
description: MCP server for the EGLO BLE Bridge (talks to the bridges via MQTT)

scripts.bundle: esbuild server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=build/server.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.mcpb: npm run bundle && rm -rf pack && mkdir -p pack/server && cp manifest.json pack/ && cp build/server.mjs pack/server/ && mcpb pack pack eglo-bridge.mcpb
